title: SQL Injection
description: Concatenation-based SQL query built from unsanitized user input.
remediation: Use parameterized queries or an ORM.

title: Cross-Site Scripting
description: Reflected XSS via unescaped user input in search results page.
remediation: Sanitize and encode all user-supplied output.

title: Cross-Site Request Forgery
description: Missing CSRF token validation on form submission endpoint.
remediation: Add CSRF token validation to all state-changing endpoints.

title: Header Manipulation
description: HTTP response header constructed from unsanitized input.
remediation: Validate and sanitize all values used in HTTP headers.

title: Insufficiently Protected Credentials
remediation: Avoid encoding security-sensitive parameters; validate and encrypt if required.
